metadata.title: DeepCode Studio — the AI coding agent that speaks Arabic
metadata.description: Reads your repo, writes reviewable diffs and runs your tests. Native Arabic and English, OpenCode Go models, on Windows, macOS and Linux.

footer.tagline: An AI coding agent for Arabic and English, on Windows, macOS and Linux.

landing.heroTitle: An IDE fluent in Arabic and in code.
landing.heroSub: Agents that read your repo, write diffs and run the terminal — with a fully native Arabic interface, and one metered multi-model gateway.
landing.proofRtl: Native Arabic UI with fully isolated code
landing.proofLocal: Your keys on your machine, ours on our servers
landing.agenticBody: A task becomes a plan, the plan becomes edits, and the edits render as reviewable diffs next to a terminal that actually runs.
landing.mcpBody: MCP servers over stdio or SSE, with curated cloud presets delivered to your machine signed.
landing.skillsBody: One SKILL.md adds a full capability; your local skills always shadow the managed ones.
landing.gatewayBody: One virtual key, protocol adapters for every upstream API, exact per-token metering with a live HUD.

faq.creditBody: A credit equals the list price of the model you used: input and output tokens are converted to credits at each model's per-million price. Details live in the model price table.
faq.limitBody: New requests stop and a renewal dialog appears inside the app. Nothing is auto-charged and an in-flight answer is never cut.
faq.byok: Can I use my own keys?
faq.byokBody: Yes. A custom-providers section is available under Advanced settings and keeps working even while a subscription is inactive.
faq.dataBody: We never store request or response content; only token counts, for metering. App credentials are encrypted on your device.
faq.refundBody: Cancel any time and access continues until the end of the paid period. Refund requests are reviewed case by case; the terms page has the full policy.
faq.osBody: Windows 10/11, macOS 12+ (Intel or Apple Silicon), and Linux AppImage/deb/rpm on x64 and arm64.
faq.offlineBody: Editing and reviewing always work locally; cloud models need a connection, and you can wire a local provider.
faq.zcode: What is the relation to ZCode?
faq.zcodeBody: The app is built on ZCodium, an Apache-2.0 open-source fork, with a full DeepCode identity and Arabic interface.

legal.licensesBody: DeepCode Studio is built on ZCodium (Apache-2.0). We keep LICENSE and NOTICE.md unchanged and document our changes in a "DeepCode Studio modifications" section.

terms.p: DeepCode Studio is an AI coding environment made of a desktop app, a web portal, and a gateway that forwards your requests to model providers. By using the service you agree to these terms.

You need an account with an email address or a Google account. You are responsible for keeping your account, API keys and linked devices secure, and for all use made through them. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorised use.

Each plan gives you credits for the subscription period, charged by model price and token count. When credits run out, requests stop until renewal or upgrade; there is never an automatic charge. Unused credits do not roll over and cannot be exchanged for cash.

Payment is prepaid via UPI. A plan is activated after we confirm the amount and transaction reference (UTR) were received. If we cannot activate a plan you paid for, we refund it in full; other refund requests are reviewed case by case.

Models are provided by third parties and may change, be withdrawn or change price. Model output can be wrong; review any code or content before using it. Some free models may let their provider train on conversations; this is marked next to the model.
Your use is subject to the Acceptable Use Policy. We may suspend or terminate any account that breaches it or puts the service or others at risk.

The service is provided “as is”. We work to keep it running but do not guarantee it will be uninterrupted. To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the three months before the claim.
You can delete your account at any time from Settings. We may end the service for any account that breaches these terms.
We may update these terms and show the date at the top of this page; continuing to use the service means you accept the updated version. For questions about these terms, use the Support page.

privacy.p: Account data: name, email address and a hashed password (or your Google account ID). Linked devices: name, operating system, app version and last seen time. Usage data: model used, token counts, cost, status and timing. Payment data: amount, transaction reference (UTR) and status.

We do not store the content of your messages or the code you send to models. It passes through the gateway to the model provider only to complete the request. We never see your card or bank account details.
To run your account, meter credits and activate plans; to protect the service from abuse (rate limits and duplicate-payment checks); and to send verification and password-reset emails.

Hosting: our own server (PostgreSQL and Redis) behind a private network and an HTTPS reverse proxy. Email delivery: our configured SMTP provider. Google sign-in, if you choose it. Model providers such as OpenCode Go receive request content only to complete it; they never receive your account password or payment details. We do not sell your data.

We keep account data while the account exists. When you delete your account from Settings its personal data is deleted; we may keep financial records and de-identified usage records as required by law or to prevent fraud.
We use strictly necessary cookies only: your sign-in session, language choice, and two-factor protection. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
You can view your data, change your name and language, and delete your account in Settings. For any other request, use the Support page.

acceptableUse.p: Using the service for anything illegal; to create malware or intrusion tools aimed at systems you are not authorised to test; for fraud or phishing; for content that exploits minors; or for harassment and threats.

Selling, sharing or reselling API keys or model access; circumventing rate, credit or device limits; creating multiple accounts to obtain free credits; or trying to access other users' data or parts of the service not available to you.
Flooding the service with excessive automated requests or using it in a way that affects its stability for others.
Your use must also comply with the policies of the model providers your requests are sent to.
On a breach we may warn, suspend or terminate the account and revoke its keys. You can write to us to appeal any action.

security.title: Security
security.sub: How DeepCode Studio protects your account and data.
security.accountBody: Passwords are hashed. API keys are stored hashed and shown once. Upstream provider keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
security.transportBody: HTTPS with HSTS, a strict Content Security Policy, frame-ancestors none and rate limits on public endpoints.
security.dataBody: We meter token counts but do not store prompt or response content by default. The privacy policy has the details.
security.reportBody: Open a private security advisory on GitHub before disclosing publicly; we will acknowledge and work on a fix.
